heading: Press & Recognition

articles.title: Platform Curation: NOT JUST A LABEL (NJAL) Feature
articles.summary: NOT JUST A LABEL features SILVER & ELEGANT, highlighting the studio's architectural jewellery and structural design approach.

sections.body:
SILVER & ELEGANT is featured by NOT JUST A LABEL (NJAL), the global platform dedicated to contemporary independent fashion.

The curation spotlights the studio's focus on micro-sculpture and Future Heirlooms — pieces engineered for structural permanence rather than seasonal trends. Conceived in London and executed by a single master artisan in Istanbul's Grand Bazaar, the work is recognized within NJAL’s curated roster of emerging independent talent.

articles.title: Runway Partnership: Paul Costelloe AW26 — London Fashion Week
articles.summary: SILVER & ELEGANT partnered with Paul Costelloe as an official jewellery partner for the Autumn/Winter 2026 London Fashion Week runway show.

sections.body:
SILVER & ELEGANT served as an official jewellery partner for Paul Costelloe's Autumn/Winter 2026 runway show at London Fashion Week, held at The Waldorf Hilton.

  

Curated alongside stylist Borna Prikaski and the Costelloe design team under William Costelloe’s creative direction, the presentation integrated our sculptural forms with structured tailoring. Conceived as micro-sculptures engineered for permanence, the pieces demonstrated the structural dialogue between monolithic metal forms and high-fashion silhouettes.

sections.quote: This partnership served as a powerful expression of our traditional craft heritage and experimental architectural lines on the high-fashion stage.

articles.title: Regional Press: Borehamwood Times Feature
articles.summary: _Borehamwood Times_ profiles SILVER & ELEGANT, covering the studio's technical foundations and runway partnership at London Fashion Week AW26.

sections.body:
_Borehamwood Times_ documents the trajectory of SILVER & ELEGANT from its Hertfordshire studio to London Fashion Week AW26.

The feature explores how founder Esen Tunalı Sarı’s background in software development informs the studio’s computational design methodology and single-artisan physical execution in Istanbul's Grand Bazaar. The article highlights the brand's emergence as an official jewellery partner to Paul Costelloe for the runway opening show during its inaugural year.

articles.title: Editorial Press: Flanelle Magazine — Shadow and Metal
articles.summary: _Flanelle Magazine_ features SILVER & ELEGANT, highlighting the interplay between geometric mass, shadow, and metallic surfaces.

sections.body:
SILVER & ELEGANT’s sculptural forms are featured in a contemporary fashion editorial for _Flanelle Magazine_.

The feature focuses on the studio’s sharp geometry, documenting the contrast between shadow and light across structural metallic surfaces. Conceived as Future Heirlooms engineered for permanence, the pieces are captured as micro-sculptures situated within a stark, high-fashion visual framework.

articles.title: Editorial Press: KALTBLUT Magazine — "THE DISH"
articles.summary: SILVER & ELEGANT’s sculptural pieces are curated in _KALTBLUT Magazine_’s digital editorial, "THE DISH" — situating structural form within avant-garde creative direction.

sections.body:
SILVER & ELEGANT’s designs are featured in "THE DISH," a digital editorial published by _KALTBLUT Magazine_.

The curation focuses on the sculptural posture, physical weight, and structural strength of our forms on the body. Conceived as Future Heirlooms engineered for permanence, the pieces serve as distinct architectural anchors within the publication’s visual direction.

SILVER & ELEGANT founder and creative director Esen Tunalı Sarı has been elected a Fellow of the Royal Society of Arts (FRSA).

The appointment recognizes a design methodology rooted in software development and realized through single-artisan physical execution in Istanbul's Grand Bazaar. By bridging computational precision with the material weight of classical metalwork, the studio approaches jewellery not as ornament, but as an enduring structural discipline.

articles.title: Fellowship of the Royal Society of Arts: Esen Tunalı Sarı, FRSA
articles.summary: Esen Tunalı Sarı has been elected as a Fellow of the Royal Society of Arts (FRSA), marking institutional recognition for the studio's intersection of computational methodologies and traditional metalwork.

sections.body:
SILVER & ELEGANT is featured in the March 2026 Jewellery Guide curated by independent design platform Wolf & Badger.

The curation spotlights the studio's focus on micro-sculpture and Future Heirlooms — physical pieces engineered for structural permanence rather than seasonal trends. Conceived in London and executed by a single master artisan in Istanbul's Grand Bazaar, the work is presented as part of Wolf & Badger's global edit of independent design.

articles.title: Curatorial Selection: Wolf & Badger Jewellery Guide
articles.summary: Wolf & Badger includes SILVER & ELEGANT in its March 2026 Jewellery Guide, spotlighting the studio's architectural silhouettes to its international audience.

sections.body:
SILVER & ELEGANT is named a Finalist in the Business Innovation category at the SME Hertfordshire Business Awards 2026.

The nomination recognizes the studio’s proprietary Physical Fidelity Protocol™ — a constraint-based generative methodology that eliminates conventional camera photography and post-production. Visuals are synthesized computationally while maintaining exact geometric truth with physical pieces crafted by a single master artisan in Istanbul’s Grand Bazaar.

The recognition reflects a deliberate operational model: pairing algorithmic precision with singular, enduring metalwork to construct Future Heirlooms. The Grand Final takes place on 17 September 2026.

articles.title: Award Recognition: Finalist at the SME Hertfordshire Business Awards 2026
articles.summary: SILVER & ELEGANT has been named a Business Innovation Finalist at the SME Hertfordshire Business Awards 2026, recognizing the studio’s generative methodology and production discipline.
